name: alexwengg/nanbeige4.3-33b-mlx-mixed-3-4-6bit
title: Nanbeige4.3-33B mixed 3/4/6-bit MLX build fits in 15.7 GiB and runs as a terminal agent on a 24 GB M5 Pro
summary: A community MLX quant of the new Nanbeige4.3-33B coding model mixes 3, 4 and 6 bit layers to land at 15.7 GiB, so it loads on a 24 GB Apple Silicon laptop. The author shows it fixing a buggy repo end to end as a terminal agent at about 25 tok/s.
